prompts.conversation: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: artwork for a 16:9 NSPA scholarship-provider workshop slide. Primary request: a stunning editorial infographic illustration about adults building meaning through conversation. Wide landscape 3:2 canvas. Four diverse fictional adult scholarship reviewers, drawn as elegant sculptural paper-cut figures, sit around an open circular discussion space; each contributes a differently colored translucent ribbon that interweaves in the center into a clear shared lens. Make each perspective visibly distinct yet connected. Teal #007681, pale aqua #E4F4F4, slate #2E4F66, orange #FF7233 and gold #FFCD34, on a clean pale aqua background. Sophisticated layered paper and glass, restrained dimensionality, crisp shadows, beautiful editorial finish, visually legible from the back of a conference room. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no tiny details, no frames, no UI panels. Leave generous breathing space around the main composition. No real people. The image must communicate relationships and shared understanding, not technology.
prompts.evidence: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: stunning landscape editorial infographic artwork for an NSPA scholarship review workshop. A conceptual evidence-checking scene in refined layered paper-cut and frosted glass style. On the left a beautifully polished slate-and-teal summary document floats above a clean aqua work surface; on the right the underlying source packet is open, with one golden empty page slot and a small orange conflicting instruction slip visibly separated from the factual pages. A large transparent magnifying lens spans between summary and source, revealing the empty slot through its glass. The image must show why a polished summary still needs checking against source evidence. Wide 3:2 composition, large simple forms, teal #007681, pale aqua #E4F4F4, slate #2E4F66, gold #FFCD34 and orange #FF7233. Museum-quality editorial finish, beautifully lit, subtle shadows. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, readable fake writing or UI panels. Abstract short strokes on documents are acceptable but no words. Keep outer edges spacious. Fictional teaching illustration.
prompts.perspectives: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: landscape NSPA workshop slide artwork. Stunning paper-cut editorial illustration of two fictional adult scholarship reviewers looking through two separate translucent lenses at the same open application document in the center. One lens highlights a golden goal motif, the other an orange change motif; both highlight different real aspects of one document without implying one person is right. A delicate teal ribbon joins their perspectives above the page. Clean aqua background, teal #007681, slate #2E4F66, gold #FFCD34, orange #FF7233. Wide 3:2 canvas, large intelligible shapes, sophisticated tactile paper and glass, generous negative space, crisp dimensional lighting. No text, numbers, logos, fake words or UI frames. Communicate listening to another person's reasons before relying on an AI rating.
prompts.workflow: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: wide panoramic artwork for NSPA presentation. A stunning editorial paper-cut and sculptural infographic of a scholarship review workflow. Exactly THREE prominent checkpoint arches, evenly spaced left to right on a single clear aqua pathway: first gold arch contains a protected document and a human hand approving the input; second teal arch contains a large transparent magnifying glass above a document, checking source evidence; third slate arch contains a fictional human reviewer carefully holding the final decision document. A small orange pause marker lies beside the path as a side route for concerns. Make the human ownership evident. Teal #007681, pale aqua #E4F4F4, slate #2E4F66, orange #FF7233 and gold #FFCD34, soft pale aqua background. Wide 16:9 composition designed as a large central band, precise spacing, tactile editorial finish, beautifully lit, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI cards. Keep all three arches fully visible.
prompts.reflection: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reflection slide artwork for an NSPA workshop. A calm, exquisite landscape editorial illustration in sculptural layered paper and frosted glass. A simple open notebook on a quiet pale aqua desk with a single gold pencil resting diagonally beside it. Above the notebook, two translucent teal and orange ribbons that were previously separate gently settle into one clear overlapping shape, suggesting reconsideration. Emphasize spaciousness and silence, with large empty areas and soft light, not busy detail. Wide 3:2, NSPA teal #007681, pale aqua #E4F4F4, slate #2E4F66, gold #FFCD34, restrained orange #FF7233. No words, no letters, no numbers, no people, no logos, no UI panels. Beautiful tactile editorial art suitable for a slide that holds still while adults think.
prompts.fair: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: NSPA workshop slide artwork about a fair applicant conversation. Stunning layered paper-cut editorial scene of a fictional adult scholarship applicant and a fictional adult reviewer seated at equal height across an open table. Between them a teal published-rule document and two translucent overlapping speech shapes, one gold and one aqua. A small orange detector warning symbol sits off to the side, clearly secondary to the human conversation, with no percentage or score. Their posture is open, listening, respectful; no accusation, no interrogation. Wide 3:2 canvas, teal #007681, aqua #E4F4F4, slate #2E4F66, orange #FF7233, gold #FFCD34. Large simple forms, sculptural paper texture and glass, tasteful editorial finish, bright clean background. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI cards. No real person likeness.
prompts.change: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: panoramic NSPA closing slide artwork. A stunning sculptural paper-cut editorial infographic showing one small change growing through a colleague's feedback. Exactly three visual moments across one connected teal ribbon pathway on a pale aqua background: left, a hand places one small golden seed-shaped marker onto a written plan with abstract short lines; center, two fictional adult colleagues examine a small teal seedling together through a transparent lens, one holding an orange observation slip; right, a modest healthy teal plant with a few gold leaves next to a revised plan, suggesting an improved practice, not a guaranteed outcome. Wide 16:9, spacious, large simple forms. NSPA teal #007681, slate #2E4F66, aqua #E4F4F4, orange #FF7233, gold #FFCD34. Museum-quality layered paper and frosted glass, beautifully lit. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no giant trees, no UI panels.
prompts.learning: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: panoramic NSPA workshop infographic illustration. Exactly FOUR equally spaced distinct visual stages along one gently connected teal ribbon on a clean very pale aqua background. Left to right: 1 a single adult hand with a gold pencil above a small blank notebook for quiet thinking; 2 two overlapping translucent speech shapes in teal and gold for sharing perspectives; 3 a large transparent magnifying lens examining the overlap between two different colored document fragments for examining a difference; 4 a hand revising a simple page using an orange pencil for changing a practice. No humans beyond the two small hands needed. Wide 16:9, four clear visual clusters but no cards or frames. Stunning tactile layered paper and frosted glass editorial style, crisp dimensional shadows, teal #007681, slate #2E4F66, pale aqua #E4F4F4, gold #FFCD34 and orange #FF7233. Huge legible forms and ample negative space. No text, numbers, letters, logos, no AI robots, no UI panels. Keep four stages visually separated and fully visible for typeset labels to be added outside the image.
